name: Builtin Cluster S08: Cumulative Aggregation Variants
description: Tests: cumulative(agg=Sum/Product/Max/Min/Mean/Median/Std/Var/Quantile/Skew/Kurtosis/Count/First/Last/All/Any/CountDistinct/Mode), arg_min, arg_max, arg_minmax. All AggregationType enum values.
source:
# =============================================================================
# BUILTIN CLUSTER S08: Cumulative Aggregation Variants
# =============================================================================

src = market_data_source()()
close = src.c

ret = returns()(close)
ret_plus_1 = ret + 1
signal = close > sma(period=50)(close)

# === CUMULATIVE AGG: Numeric variants ===
cum_sum = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Sum)(ret)
cum_prod = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Product)(ret_plus_1)
cum_max = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Max)(close)
cum_min = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Min)(close)
cum_mean = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Mean)(close)
cum_median = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Median)(close)
cum_std = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Std)(close)
cum_var = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Var)(close)
cum_q75 = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Quantile, q=0.75)(close)
cum_skew = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Skew)(ret)
cum_kurt = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Kurtosis)(ret)
cum_count = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Count)(close)
cum_first = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.First)(close)
cum_last = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Last)(close)

# === CUMULATIVE AGG: Boolean/discrete variants ===
cum_all = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.All)(signal)
cum_any = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Any)(signal)
cum_cd = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.CountDistinct)(signal)
cum_mode = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Mode)(signal)

# === ARG MIN / ARG MAX / ARG MINMAX ===
amin = arg_min()(close)
amax = arg_max()(close)
aminmax = arg_minmax()(close)

# === REPORTERS ===
xy_lines(
    title='Cumulative Sum & Product of Returns',
    category='Cumulative',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Cum Sum', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Cum Product', color=Color.Green)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=(cum_sum, cum_prod))

xy_lines(
    title='Cumulative Max/Min/Mean of Close',
    category='Cumulative',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Cum Max', color=Color.Red),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Cum Min', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Cum Mean', color=Color.Green)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=(cum_max, cum_min, cum_mean))

xy_lines(
    title='Cumulative Std / Skew / Kurtosis',
    category='Cumulative Stats',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Std', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Skew', color=Color.Green),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Kurtosis', color=Color.Red)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=(cum_std, cum_skew, cum_kurt))

xy_lines(
    title='Arg Min / Arg Max',
    category='Arg Extremes',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Arg Min', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Arg Max', color=Color.Red)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=(amin, amax))
